title: import: a text column whose values end in a number ("Imported QA task 1") is inferred as Date, because type inference trusts Date.parse
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Tasks → Import → upload a CSV whose Title column holds `Imported QA task 1`, `Imported QA task 2`: the mapping step labels the column **Date** and warns "Looks like Date" under the Title mapping.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the console / records owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of the end-user console on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue，然后继续测试前端」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

Type inference marks a plain text column as a date whenever every sampled value happens to end in a number.

## Where it comes from (read in source)

`isDateLike` in `plugin-grid/src/importParsers.ts` is `s => !isNumberLike(s) && !isNaN(Date.parse(s))`. V8's `Date.parse` is lenient: `Date.parse('Phase 2')` → 2001-02-01, `'Building 7'` → 2001-07-01, `'Room 12'` → 2001-12-01, `'Imported QA task 1'` → 2001-01-01 (measured in Node 22). So names, codes and addresses ending in a digit all read as dates.

## Expected

Only strings that look like dates (ISO, locale numeric dates, month names with a day/year) infer as date; everything else stays text.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Gate `isDateLike` on an explicit pattern set (ISO-8601, `\d{1,4}[-/.]\d{1,2}[-/.]\d{1,4}`, month-name forms) before calling `Date.parse`; add the strings above as regression cases next to the existing `importParsers` tests.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.
